$comment: Plain-Urdu and short-form corrections to the CLDR place names the app shows, the extra words a country is found by, and the zones suggested first when a phone gives only its clock's offset. tool/l10n/place_names.py applies them to tool/l10n/cldr_places.json and writes app/lib/src/core/place_names.g.dart (make place-names). Every entry says why; a code or zone the app does not store is refused.

US.reason: CLDR's own short Urdu form; the formal ریاست ہائے متحدہ امریکہ is office Urdu.

ES.reason: What people say; CLDR's ہسپانیہ is literary.

HM.reason: CLDR joins the two names with the Persian conjunction (a lone waw) where Urdu says اور, and misspells McDonald (میکڈولینڈ).

UM.ur: امریکا کے چھوٹے دور کے جزیرے
UM.reason: CLDR misspells جزائز; this says plainly what the islands are.

HK.reason: CLDR's short forms, so both languages say the same thing (its long form has a Latin SAR in the Urdu).

MO.reason: CLDR's short forms, so both languages say the same thing (its long form has a Latin SAR in the Urdu).

PS.reason: CLDR's short forms, so both languages say the same thing.

AU.reason: zone.tab lists Lord Howe Island, Macquarie Island, Hobart and Broken Hill before the big cities that share their clocks; a phone gives only its offset, so the big city is suggested first.

BR.reason: zone.tab lists Belem and other cities before Sao Paulo, whose clock most of Brazil's people share.

GB.reason: How people name the United Kingdom, in either language.

US.reason: How people name the United States, and the other common Urdu spelling.

AE.reason: People name the Emirates by its short form or its cities.

SA.reason: Short forms people use for Saudi Arabia.

NL.reason: The name most people use for the Netherlands.

QA.reason: Qatar is often named by its capital.

OM.reason: Oman is often named by its capital.
